publication_citations.cite: Colorado SB 26-189 (2026 Regular Session), Governor Signed May 14, 2026

timeline.notes: Section 5 distinguishes enactment, provisions effective on passage, and the January 1, 2027 general commencement.

Section 5(2) includes the Attorney General rulemaking directives in §§6-1-1704(4) and 6-1-1705(3), the party-joinder provision in §6-1-1706(6), and the insurance commissioner’s authority to adopt or update insurer notice and disclosure rules under §10-3-1104.9(3)(e). It also includes act §§4–6.

The Colorado Secretary of State’s eDocket for 4 CCR 904-6 (tracking 2026-00360) lists November 19 as the adoption date and November 20 as the date an Attorney General opinion was requested. The November 24 docket observation supplies no effective date for the rules.
Developer, deployer, consumer-rights, recordkeeping, and cure obligations apply to consequential decisions on or after this date
